title: Eventual equality on an affine etale object
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : I^op → Scheme a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, c a limiting cone, i₀ a stage, G a sheaf of sets on D(i₀), and W₀ an affine etale object over D(i₀) whose structure map is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For stages j,k over i₀ and sections s,t of the pulled-back sheaf on the base changes of W₀, equality under the canonical cone section comparisons [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison] implies equality under the canonical transition comparisons after arrows from some common later stage. This statement is restricted to affine W₀.

source.place: Tag 09YQ, affine-site proof using Tags 0EYL, 04HR and 09YN; affine restriction of the parent node proof

proof.text: Pass to the cofinal tail and an affine-site presentation. Restrict the inverse-image sheaves along the affine-site equivalences, using the unit-compatible inverse-image comparison. Composition identifies their limit pullbacks with a constant diagram. Its colimit is the limit inverse image; the colimit-of-sites section theorem identifies affine sections with the filtered colimit of the stage section sets, compatibly with the displayed units and pullback pasting.

Apply the filtered-colimit equality criterion to the two stage representatives. It produces arrows into a common later index. Transport back through the comparison identifications; the section comparison laws identify the resulting maps with the displayed transitions.

theorem etaleSetSectionAffineEventualEquality
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (G : Sheaf (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (W₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) [QuasiCompact W₀.hom] [QuasiSeparated W₀.hom]
    [IsAffine W₀.left]
    (j k : Over (op i₀)) (s : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (D.map j.hom)).obj G).obj.obj
        (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map j.hom)).obj W₀)))
    (t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (D.map k.hom)).obj G).obj.obj
        (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map k.hom)).obj W₀)))
 :
    (etaleSetSectionComparison (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom)
      (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom) G W₀) s =
      (etaleSetSectionComparison (c.π.app k.left) (D.map k.hom)
        (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w k.hom) G W₀) t →
    ∃ (l : Over (op i₀)) (a : l ⟶ j) (b : l ⟶ k),
      (etaleSetSectionComparison (D.map a.left) (D.map j.hom) (D.map l.hom)
          ((D.map_comp a.left j.hom).symm.trans
            (congrArg (fun t : l.left ⟶ op i₀ ↦ D.map t) a.w)) G W₀) s =
        (etaleSetSectionComparison (D.map b.left) (D.map k.hom) (D.map l.hom)
          ((D.map_comp b.left k.hom).symm.trans
            (congrArg (fun t : l.left ⟶ op i₀ ↦ D.map t) b.w)) G W₀) t
